overview.about: The Summer Olympic Games are the world's biggest sporting event - around 10,000 athletes from more than 200 nations competing across 30-plus sports every four years. First held in their modern form in Athens in 1896, the Games are as much a global cultural moment as a sporting one. Los Angeles hosts in 2028, for a record third time. The Games run 14-31 July 2028.
overview.nextEvent: The 2028 Summer Olympics run 14-31 July in Los Angeles, the third time the city has hosted after 1932 and 1984. Around 3,000 medals are decided across the fortnight, with new sports on the programme and events spread across venues throughout Southern California.
